deviations.reason: The wireframe draws icons as text glyphs (plus, magnifier, triangle...); the app uses Tabler icons. A text difference that is only these glyphs is allowed.
A text glyph sits in a line box (about 20px tall); an SVG icon is its own height. Width and x still must match.
The wireframe is grayscale on purpose; the app uses Vanta color tokens. Structure (filled vs not) is still compared; hue is not.
The wireframe draws three gray dots for the window controls; the app uses the native macOS traffic lights.
An icon-only element (Tabler SVG) has no text node, so it reports no font size or weight; the wireframe's text glyph reports its 12-15px glyph font. Box geometry (x, w, radius) is still compared.
